Patna Home Guards Protest : patna men somvar ko grihrakshakon ne apni vibhinn mangon ko lekar pradarshan kiya. bari sankhya men grihrakshak gandhi maidan ke pas jute. iske bad vahan se march karte hue chhajjubag sthit bihar grih raksha vahini mukhyalay pahunche. yahan mahanideshak sah mahasmadeshta ke karyalay ke samne dharna shuru kar diya. is aandolan ka aahvan bihar rakshavahini svayansevak sangh ne kiya hai.
